empty: No kills recorded for this event yet. They appear once a debugger file or AFC Capture sends the maps.
loadError: Kill stats could not be loaded.

sniper.title: Sniper kills recorded
sniper.lead: Kills with a bolt-action rifle (AWM, M82B, Kar98k, M24). Only kills where the game reported the weapon count, so this is what was recorded, not every sniper kill.

h2h.title: Head to head
h2h.lead: Every fight between two teams. A fight ends after 30 seconds with no kill or knock among its teams. A team that comes in while it is going is the third party: it joins the same fight, and each team it fought counts in its own row. Tap a pair to see each fight.
h2h.whoTitle: Who killed and knocked who, {a} v {b}

players.title: Player head to head
players.lead: Who killed and knocked who. Pick a player to see every opponent they met in a fight, with the kills and the knocks each way, the picked player's number first. A knock counts as a knock even when the player was revived.

csvError: The CSV could not be downloaded.

staff.always: Always open here for AFC admins and this event's organizers.
staff.on: The Kill stats tab on the public event page is switched on, so players see the same tables (not the two cards below).
staff.off: The Kill stats tab on the public event page is switched off: nothing here is shown to players until it is turned on.

weapons.title: Weapons used
weapons.lead: Kills per gun, by the name the game shows players, for the kills where the game reported the weapon. Versions of one gun count as that gun.
weapons.empty: No kill with a known weapon yet.

missing.title: Not recorded yet
missing.lead: What the game's files do not give the site today. Each one appears here once it can be read from the game's replay files, which are being worked out.

zone.title: Time outside the safe zone, per team
zone.body: Needs every player's position through the match. The observer's log only has positions at kills and respawns.

damage.title: Damage dealt and taken
damage.body: The log has it for the player the observer is watching, not for the others.

revive.title: Who revived who
revive.body: The log says a player came back, not who brought them back.

grenade.title: Where each grenade was thrown
grenade.body: The log counts grenades used, without a place.
